messages:
anna: Heads-up — CS escalated OrchidPay P1. They’re seeing a spike in p99 tail after model variant swap. Need a quick sync: can eng-platform commit to timeline for a hotpatch/canary?

miguel: Thanks. Are we confident this is routing/backpressure on dedicated pools vs. a model-level kv-cache bug? Any logs/trace? @sara can you paste context?

sara: Logs point to queueing on pool-3 during variant rotation, caused by transient GC + heavier decode for the new variant. I have a small fix (backoff + pin variant briefly) that reduces head-of-line blocking.

sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/6789 — tiny change, adds variant pin + soften fallback. Needs 1 reviewer and a canary deploy.

anna: CS needs a firm ETA to tell the customer. If we can say patch in ~4-6h or faster that's great. They asked about rollback plan too.

tom: Checklist to share: 1) PR review & merge 2) canary deploy to pool-3 with 5% traffic 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 + errors for 15m 4) promote or rollback. I can take on-call for the window.

miguel: I can own the rollout. @infra-bot open a high-priority hotfix ticket and tag OrchidPay/P1.

infra-bot: Created ticket: INF-91234 — "orchidpay-hotpatch" assigned to miguel. Priority: P1. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-91234

anna: CS asked for a hard ETA within 30m. Can we give T+4h as a conservative estimate if we start now?

sara: With a reviewer and infra ticket we should be able to get canary in ~3-4h. If reviewer is free we can do faster. Miguel — can you review now so we have slippage cushion?

miguel: Reviewing PR now. Quick pass, leave comments if any. I’ll merge and trigger canary once green.

anna: I told CS we'd update them at T+30m with an owner and ETA. I'll wait for your confirmation here.

tom: Runbook snippet (for quick paste to CS & SRE):
```
- merge PR
- deploy canary to pool-3 (route 5% OrchidPay)
- observe metrics for 15 min: p50/p95/p99, error rate, latency heatmap
- rollback if p99 increases >10% vs baseline or error rate >0.5%
- promote to full if stable
```

sara: OK PR looks small, addressed a nits comment. Miguel if you approve I’ll rerun CI and prep deploy manifest.

miguel: APPROVED. Merging in ~8m after CI. I’ll update this thread with timestamps.

anna: Thanks — CS will hold the customer message until we confirm.

miguel: MERGED and started canary pipeline at 2356789038. Link to pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/3498

sara: Canary live at 5% routing to canary pool-3. Initial metrics: p99 +2% (within threshold), error rate 0.02%.

tom: 15m checkpoint: p99 back to baseline. No error spikes. Proceeding to full rollout in 10m.

miguel: Full rollout initiated at 2356789050. Monitoring closely.

infra-bot: Deploy Event: DEPLOY-3498 completed from canary->stable by miguel. Details: https://deploys.redwood.ai/DEPLOY-3498

anna: CS notified and customer updated with conservative ETA fulfilled. Thank you all — I’ll follow up with postmortem notes and impact metrics later.

miguel: Leaving notes on INF-91234 and will attach perf graphs. Closing this loop once CS confirms customer baseline recovered.
